Hi, does anyone know where I can buy adjustable plate holders (from 4"x5" up to 30cm x 40cm) preferably in the UK (new or 2nd hand). I'm also after a collimating mirror - suitable for holography - I'm using an 8'x10' table and would like to go up to 30x40cm with my transfers.

If you do have any suggestions - my e-mail address is: pearlv at hotmail dot com.

Many thanks,

Pearl
